title: Haunted Wasteland
description: Follow L/R instructions through a node network, using LCM for ghost paths.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse the L/R instruction string and build a network mapping each node to its left and right neighbors.

## Part 1

Start at `AAA` and follow the instruction sequence (cycling as needed) until reaching `ZZZ`. Count the steps.

## Part 2

Multiple ghosts start simultaneously at all nodes ending with `A` and must all land on `Z`-nodes at the same step. Brute-force simulation would take astronomical time. The key observation is that each ghost's path is periodic — it reaches its `Z`-node at a fixed cycle length. Find each ghost's cycle length independently, then take the LCM of all cycle lengths to find the first step where all ghosts align. This relies on a deliberate property of the puzzle input: each ghost has exactly one `Z`-node in its cycle and the cycle length equals the offset.
